[[Pokéstar Studios]] }} '''Movie Panic''' (Japanese: '''VSバルチャイ''' ''VS {{tt|Valchai|Vullaby}}''), titled '''VS Vullaby''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 530th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the sixth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Vullaby''' (Japanese: '''ムービーズ・パニック''' ''Movies Panic'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Movie Panic''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Cheren}} takes the class on a trip to [[Pokéstar Studios]]. * [[Brycen]] is revealed to have quit his job as a [[Gym Leader]] to return to acting while [[Sabrina]] is revealed to have become a {{tc|Movie Star|famous actress}}. * {{adv|Whitley}} participates in a movie, only for the Mecha {{p|Tyranitar}} prop to attack everyone in sight. * {{adv|Blake}} defeats the Mecha Tyranitar prop, much to Whitley's frustration. * Brycen suggests that Cheren become the Gym Leader of the [[Aspertia Gym]]. * {{adv|White}} is revealed to have had a part in Pokéstar Studios's creation. * [[Hugh]] finds Whitley's pendant, which contains a microchip inside. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * Stu Deeoh ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Shellos}} (West Sea) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} (flashback) * {{adv|White}} * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|N}} (fantasy) * [[Sabrina]] * [[Brycen]] * [[Iris]] (flashback) * [[Marlon]] (flashback) * [[Colress]] (fantasy) * [[Zinzolin]] (flashback) * [[Hugh]] * [[Leo]] * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} * {{adv|Yuki}} * Stu Deeoh * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s (fantasy) * Students * Movie director * Assistant ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Vullaby}} (Barbara;
